text:
maria: quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8423 updates authz for private deployments. Main changes: replace shared env secret usage with KMS-encrypted per-tenant keys, add rotate_secret script, and update VPC onboarding docs. Need eng-security review + approval to merge. Targeting merge Thu 09:00 PT. @sam @elena @liam

sam: looking now. main question: does the new per-tenant key model require tenant-role binding in KMS? also want to keep HSM-backed KMS optional. can you add the IAM snippet and note the opt-in HSM path? :eyes:

maria: yes — the PR adds tenant-role binding and an opt-in HSM flag. I added a terraform patch in `infra/kms` and noted it in the PR description. snippet included in the PR: ```resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "tenant_bind" {
  crypto_key_id = var.key_id
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:${var.tenant_sa}"]
}```

elena: thanks. two security items: 1) migration path for existing shared secrets — how are we rewrapping them? 2) audit/logging — we need a retention and an alert on rewrap failures. also, for on-prem installs, does this change require customers to run the rewrap script manually or can we support an automated agent?

maria: migration: added `scripts/secret_rewrap.py` that can take a csv of tenant IDs and rewrap secrets using a service account. for on-prem, it's opt-in — there's a flag `--enable-rewrap-agent` in the installer. audit logs: rewrap entries are emitted to Cloud Logging/Stackdriver; added a logging sink and a recommended retention policy in `docs/security/rekeying.md`.

liam: CI is failing on infra stage (fr-infra) with permission errors. please don't merge until `infra-ci` passes. also please add a post-merge canary (2-hour window) targeting dedicated-pool-2. I'd prefer merge during the quiet window to reduce blast radius.

maria: agreed — I'll wait on infra-ci and schedule a canary 2 hours after merge. planning Fri 02:00 UTC window. pinging deploy-bot to reserve the window.

deploy-bot: deploy window reserved Fri 02:00 UTC → Fri 04:00 UTC. autoredeploy disabled for the window. :white_check_mark:

sam: left a couple of small code nits inline (naming + a missing unit test for `tenant_key_manager`). security-wise LGTM after the IAM snippet is added and the retention alert is wired up.

elena: +1 after an audit-alerting ticket is created so SOC has a tracking item. please link ticket number in PR.

maria: created INFSEC-412 (Rewrap audit alerts) and linked it in the PR description. updated the IAM snippet per Sam's comment and added a retention policy section. will merge once infra-ci is green and infra team gives final thumbs.

liam: sounds good — thanks for handling the migration notes. :thumbsup:
